thread:
Priya Sharma: Hey team — our org owner (me) suddenly gets a 403 when opening the Billing tab in the console. I was able to view it yesterday. We ran an infra change yesterday that applied an org-level policy via Terraform, could that have done it?

Alex Chen: Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the exact error or screenshot? Is the UI saying "permission denied" or is it a console API error?

Priya Sharma: UI shows a small banner: "You do not have permission to view billing for this organization (403)". I clicked the Download invoices button and got a popup. I'm the org owner.

Jordan (Eng): Priya — quick verification: can you confirm your role shows as Org Owner under Settings > Members? Sometimes role display vs effective permissions differ.

Priya Sharma: It still shows Org Owner in Members. Email: priya@custco.com

Maya (SRE): @Alex @Jordan FYI deploy-bot alerted about a new org-policy terraform apply yesterday evening (policy name: block-billing-automation). Could be related.

deploy-bot: terraform apply completed by infra-cicd at 2026-03-16T19:12:03Z — policy: block-billing-automation (org-scope)

Alex Chen: Can you try the API to fetch billing info and paste the curl output? Example: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X GET "https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/orgs/<ORG_ID>/billing/invoices"
```

Priya Sharma: Ran it and got: 

```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "access_denied",
  "message": "action:billing.invoices.view blocked by policy: block-billing-automation"
}
```

Jordan (Eng): That error is a smoking gun — the org policy is explicitly blocking the billing action. Why would an org-level deny be applied to org owners? Terraform policy probably lacked an exception for the role.

Maya (SRE): Searching the policy repo... found the rule. Short snippet: 

```
resource "redwood_org_policy" "block_billing" {
  name = "block-billing-automation"
  scope = "org"
  effect = "deny"
  actions = ["billing.*"]
  condition = { automation=true }
}
```

Alex Chen: Yep — actions = ["billing.*"] will deny billing.* across the org, regardless of role if deny is higher precedence. We typically implement "deny-with-exception" pattern. Did the author intend to block only service accounts?

Maya (SRE): Looks like the intent was to stop noisy automation from accessing billing APIs. They tried to scope by attribute but condition isn't excluding users with role==org_owner. Missing the exception.

Priya Sharma: Oof. How quickly can we get this restored? We need to download invoices by EOD.

Jordan (Eng): Short-term workaround: remove the policy or patch it to add an exception for principals with role org_owner and role billing_admin. We can also add a temporary allow policy with higher priority for those roles.

Alex Chen: I can roll a hotfix — either delete policy via API or patch. Propose: patch policy to add 

```
condition_exceptions = ["principal.role == 'org_owner'", "principal.role == 'billing_admin'"]
```

That should restore access immediately.

Maya (SRE): I'll coordinate with infra-cicd. Quick safe option: set policy.state = "disabled" which is atomic and reversible.

deploy-bot: policy block-billing-automation state changed -> disabled by Alex Chen at 2026-03-16T20:10:12Z

Priya Sharma: Confirmed — Billing tab loads for me now, and curl shows 200. Thank you!! :tada:

Jordan (Eng): Great. Next steps: we'll update the policy to express the intent properly and add a test to the org-policy pipeline to prevent blanket denies from blocking human roles.

Alex Chen: Action items:
- Jordan: update policy to add explicit exceptions + add unit test in repo (due 2026-03-17)
- Maya: add monitoring alert if a policy denies an action for principals in owner/admin roles (due 2026-03-18)
- Infra team: review the policy change PR and add a manual approval gate for org-scoped denies (ongoing)

Priya Sharma: Appreciate the quick fix. Please keep me posted on the permanent fix so we can close the ticket.

Maya (SRE): Will follow up with PR links and verification steps.

Alex Chen: Marking this thread resolved for support; will update when PR is merged.

Priya Sharma: Thanks again!
